svg.aria-label: An itinerary strip chart of the road from Laukuwelua to Homaitani, 83 leagues, drawn as a scroll in the manner of an old road atlas.

g.text: The ROAD from LAUKUWELUA to HOMAITANI
in The Hauwaiwa Atolls · containing 83 leagues
as it was measured by the wayfarers' chain in the year 1059
